parsed.root_cause: Kubernetes control plane components (kube-controller-manager and kube-scheduler) are unreachable, causing scheduling failures and cascading service latency.
evidence: Alert 'KubeControllerManager has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery' indicates the component is down.
Alert 'KubeScheduler has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery' indicates the scheduler is down.
K8s events show 'FailedScheduling' for multiple pods due to volume binding issues caused by the controller manager being unavailable.
High request latency and error rates in application services correlate with the inability of the control plane to schedule or manage workloads.
